gen-gf-oxanium-gf-days-one: Days One fills its line with big lowercase, each letter spaced out like rungs on a rope ladder, wide and approachable. Oxanium keeps a constant weight, like a stencil-cut channel.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-farro: Approachable Farro keeps its ascenders short and its strokes uniform. Oxanium's big lowercase and clear-ended curves take the heading spot, while the sans below stays compact and entirely unmodulated.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-geom: Commanding Oxanium brings rounded-rod strokes of a single weight, a heading with real presence. Geom carries the text with a lofty lowercase band, so paragraphs would feel approachable and unhurried.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-krona-one: Big and loosely spaced: Krona One sets lowercase with the stature of cast iron capitals. And Oxanium does its best work with clean monoline curves, free of pinched joints or flared ends.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-magra: Oxanium keeps its strokes free of any shading, while Magra gives each lowercase word a big-bodied feel. What ties them is sturdy, unfussy construction with a professional temperament.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-major-mono-display: Oxanium brings monoline strokes and open curves up top, with a lowercase that looks bigger than it is. Major Mono Display adds neon-glass tubes and generous sidebearings in a precise monospace.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-matemasie: Matemasie leaves broad gaps between glyphs and narrows the openings into its round letters, a closed look against Oxanium. Paragraphs in this sans should read cleanly and steadily.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-rambla: Clean Rambla keeps its small letters standing almost as tall as capitals, while Oxanium's curves meet stems without swelling. Body text in this sans-serif can stay modest in size.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-saira-semi-condensed: Saira Semi Condensed text looks magnified without growing, and its weight never wavers. Under Oxanium's commanding, monoline headings, this modern sans makes the strongest impression through sheer, unbroken consistency.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-secular-one: Modern in spirit, Oxanium draws distinctive headings with uninterrupted monoline strokes. Secular One follows with a dominant midsection and zero modulation, so paragraphs would feel dense and uniform.
